notes: Tidewrack, an invented quarterly of the shoreline: a homepage (lead story, second story, editor's letter and masthead) plus two long-form article pages with cross-linked related reading, one shared stylesheet, two original SVG illustrations and no JavaScript. System font stacks only; skip link, landmarks, visible focus, reduced-motion handling and fixed image dimensions are included. All people, places and findings are fictional. Known limitations: only two article pages, and the articles are short features rather than full-length pieces; no dark mode; checked only by a static link/asset script and markup review, not in a real browser or on real devices.
